title: Working with Collections
excerpt: Collections are the foundation of your content structure in HaruCMS. Learn how to organize and manage your content using collections effectively.
content:
Collections are one of the most powerful concepts in HaruCMS. They serve as the organizational structure for your content, allowing you to group related entries together and define how they should be structured. Think of collections as content types or categories that share a common schema.

What Are Collections?

A collection in HaruCMS is essentially a content type. Each collection has:

  • A unique name and slug
  • A schema defining what fields entries in that collection have
  • Settings for how entries are managed and displayed
  • Its own set of entries stored as JSON files

For example, a "Blog" collection might have fields for title, content, author, and tags, while a "Products" collection might have fields for name, price, description, and images.

Creating and Configuring Collections

When you create a new collection, you define its schema by adding fields. Each field has:

  • Name: The internal identifier (used in templates)
  • Label: The human-readable label shown in the editor
  • Type: The fieldtype (text, rich text, media, etc.)
  • Required: Whether the field must be filled
  • Default: Optional default value

You can add as many fields as needed, rearrange their order, and modify the schema at any time. Existing entries will automatically reflect schema changes.

Organizing Your Content

Collections allow you to separate different types of content logically. Common collection types include:

  • Blog: For blog posts, articles, and news
  • Pages: For static pages like About, Contact, etc.
  • Products: For e-commerce product listings
  • Team: For staff or team member profiles
  • Portfolio: For showcasing work or projects

By using separate collections, you can:

  • Apply different validation rules to different content types
  • Customize the editor interface for each collection
  • Display different content types differently on your website
  • Maintain clear separation between different kinds of content

Best Practices

When organizing content with collections:

  • Keep it simple: Don't create too many collections—group related content together
  • Plan ahead: Think about how you'll query and display content when designing collections
  • Use consistent naming: Use clear, descriptive names for collections and fields
  • Document your structure: Keep notes on why you organized collections the way you did

Collections are the foundation of a well-organized HaruCMS site. By thinking carefully about how to structure your collections, you'll create a content model that's both flexible and easy to maintain.
